title: Diagnostic Lab Franchise Opportunity
name: GKM'S Accuracy Micro Labs, 8 Franchisees, Est'd in 2020, Chennai HQ
brand: GKM'S Accuracy Micro Labs (OPC) Private Limited
description: GKM's Accuracy Micro Labs is an NABL-accredited, fully automated, barcode-enabled clinical diagnostic laboratory network with 8 company-owned branches across Chennai. We are expanding our presence by offering scalable clinical diagnostic franchise opportunities through FOFO and FOCO models. Why Invest in clinical diagnostics? 1) High demand driven by increasing lifestyle and chronic diseases. 2) Clinical diagnostics support a significant share of medical decision-making. 3) Strong long-term industry growth with recurring healthcare demand. 4) Multiple revenue streams supported by advance payments and minimal credit risk. Franchise support includes: 1) Established brand recognition and marketing support. 2) Comprehensive onboarding, training, and continuous skill development. 3) Operational support with NABL-compliant SOPs. 4) Proprietary LIMS platform with instrument integration and IT support. 5) Digital and offline marketing assistance. 6) Logistics support for faster sample collection and report delivery. 7) Business development support for doctor, clinic, and hospital partnerships. 8) Dedicated customer support services. 9) Assistance in organizing health camps and B2B tie-ups to drive business growth. 10) Attractive profit margins with a scalable business model. Average footfall: 15–20 customers per franchise outlet per day. Key differentiators: 1) Proprietary laboratory software with seamless integration across multiple instruments. 2) Scalable franchise model with opportunities for future expansion. 3) Fast turnaround time (TAT) of approximately 1–3 hours for most routine tests. 4) Defined territorial exclusivity for franchise partners. 5) Buyback option available, subject to agreed terms and conditions.
